new.title: Visit the Taksiyarhis Memorial Museum in Ayvalık
new.desc: A small church thought to date to the 15th century, on the hill above the old town. It was restored in 2012 and opened as a memorial museum in 2013, with paintings, frescoes and columns from Ayvalık's Greek Orthodox past.
new.tip: Combine it with a climb through the old streets above the bazaar.
new.q: Taksiyarhis Anıt Müzesi, Hayrettinpaşa, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: See the Saatli Camii, once Ayios Yannis church
new.desc: Built in the 1800s as the Greek church of Ayios Yannis and converted to a mosque in 1923 after the population exchange. Its clock gives the building its name.
new.tip: Visit with modest dress and outside prayer times.
new.q: Saatli Camii, Fevzipaşa, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Look into the Çınarlı Camii, former Agios Georgios
new.desc: Originally the Greek Orthodox church of Agios Georgios (Aya Yorgi), converted to a mosque after 1923. It is one of several church-mosques marking Ayvalık's Ottoman-Greek past.
new.tip: Plane trees shade the courtyard; visit outside prayer times.
new.q: Çınarlı Cami, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Watch the sunset from Şeytan Sofrası
new.desc: A hilltop about 8 km from Ayvalık with views over the Ayvalık islands, Cunda and the Greek island of Lesbos. The name means Devil's Table and a café and restaurant sit at the top.
new.tip: Minibuses run from town and Sarımsaklı; arrive an hour before sunset to get a table.
new.q: Şeytan Sofrası, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Enter the Taksiyarhis church-museum on Cunda
new.desc: A large Greek Orthodox church completed in 1873, now the Cunda Taksiyarhis Rahmi M. Koç Museum. An ayazma, a holy spring, lies beside it.
new.tip: The combined ticket also covers the Ayvalık factory museum; closed Mondays.
new.q: Cunda Taksiyarhis Rahmi M. Koç Müzesi, Alibey Adası, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Cross the causeway to Lale Adası
new.desc: Cunda is linked to the mainland and to the tiny Lale Adası (Tulip Island) by causeways. The island is known for its sunset views over the strait.
new.tip: Drive or cycle in the late afternoon; bring a drink for the sunset.
new.q: Lale Adası, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Swim at Sarımsaklı Beach
new.desc: Sarımsaklı is the best-known beach of the Ayvalık coast, a long sandy strip beside Badavut Beach and a short walk from Küçükköy.
new.tip: Go in June or September for fewer crowds; minibuses run from Ayvalık.
new.q: Sarımsaklı Plajı, Küçükköy, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Take a boat tour of the Ayvalık islands
new.desc: Ayvalık has about 22 islands in its archipelago, a nature park with coves for swimming. Day boats leave from the harbour in summer.
new.tip: Boats run in season only; book a morning departure with lunch on board.
new.q: Ayvalık İskelesi, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Eat the Ayvalık tost at Efsane Büfe
new.desc: A tost stand serving since 1969 in Ayvalık's tost bazaar. The Ayvalık tost is stuffed with sausage, pickles, cheese and sauces in a rustic bread.
new.tip: Lines build in summer; the Tostçular Çarşısı is on Atatürk Boulevard.
new.q: Efsane Büfe, Tostçular Çarşısı, Hayrettinpaşa, Atatürk Bulvarı, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Try lor tatlısı at Güler Tatlıhanesi
new.desc: A confectioner on Talatpaşa Street known for lorlu kurabiye and lor tatlısı, the baked fresh-cheese dessert of Ayvalık served with syrup and ice cream.
new.tip: Limited seating; take lor cookies away as a souvenir.
new.q: Güler Tatlıhanesi, Fevzipaşa Vehbibey, Talatpaşa Caddesi, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Share meze at Tamam Meyhane
new.desc: A meyhane in the old streets off Barbaros Street, listed in local food guides for its wide spread of meze.
new.tip: Order a mixed meze table; book in summer.
new.q: Tamam Meyhane, Hayrettinpaşa, Barbaros Caddesi 9. Sokak, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Drink koruk juice at Şeytanın Kahvesi
new.desc: A traditional coffeehouse on 13 Nisan Street, open from 06:00, known for koruk suyu (sour grape juice).
new.tip: Go in the morning; it closes at 20:00.
new.q: Şeytanın Kahvesi, Zekibey, 13 Nisan Caddesi, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Scoop karadut ice cream at Çamlık Dondurmacısı
new.desc: An ice-cream shop on İnönü Street known for black mulberry (karadut) and mastic ice cream plus supangle.
new.tip: Take a cone along the seafront promenade.
new.q: Çamlık Dondurmacısı, Sefa Çamlık, İnönü Caddesi, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Sip mastic coffee at Taş Kahve, Cunda
new.desc: A roughly 150-year-old coffeehouse on the Cunda waterfront, known for damla sakızlı Turkish coffee, sage tea and Ayvalık tost.
new.tip: Sit on the quayside; busy at weekends.
new.q: Taş Kahve, Sahil Boyu, Alibey Adası, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Taste lor cookies at Karadeniz Pastanesi, Cunda
new.desc: A pastry shop on Çarşı Street known for Ayvalık lor cookies, a syrup-soaked lor dessert and almond keşkül.
new.tip: Buy a box of lor kurabiye to take back.
new.q: Karadeniz Pastanesi, Mithatpaşa, Çarşı Caddesi, Alibey Adası, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Eat Cretan mezes at Lal Girit Mutfağı, Cunda
new.desc: A family-run Cretan kitchen serving walnut-eggplant, artichoke dolma and thyme-flavoured sole.
new.tip: Service is slow and relaxed; reservations are advised.
new.q: Lal Girit Mutfağı, Ayvalık Caddesi 20, Namık Kemal, Alibey Adası, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Order grilled sea bass at Deniz Restoran, Cunda
new.desc: A waterfront fish restaurant on Sahil Boyu known for Aegean herbs, mezes and grilled sea bass, sardines and sea bream.
new.tip: Try the papalina (small sprat) when in season.
new.q: Cunda Deniz Restaurant, Sahil Boyu 15, Fevzipaşa, Alibey Adası, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Tour the Tahtakuşlar village ethnography gallery
new.desc: Founded in 1991 by teacher Alibey Kudar, it is known as Turkey's first village museum. It shows artefacts of nomadic Turkic groups, Kaz Dağı legends and artworks, plus a library of about 10,000 books.
new.tip: The village is about 5 km from Akçay and 2 km off the E-24 highway. Phone ahead to check opening times.
new.q: Tahtakuşlar Etnografya Müzesi, Tahtakuşlar, Edremit, Balıkesir

new.title: Explore Antandros ancient city above Altınoluk
new.desc: An ancient city on Devren hill about 2.5 km east of Altınoluk, with a 1st-century Roman villa featuring frescoes and mosaics.
new.tip: The site is run by a local association; check opening before going.
new.q: Antandros Antik Kenti, Altınoluk, Edremit, Balıkesir

new.title: Reach Karataş Peak, the top of Kaz Dağı
new.desc: Karataş Tepesi, at 1,774 m, is the highest of the three summits of Kaz Dağı (Mount Ida), between Babadağ and Sarıkız Tepesi. It can be reached by vehicle road.
new.tip: Weather turns fast on the summit, so bring a layer. Summer is best; snow can close the road in winter.
new.q: Karataş Tepesi, Kaz Dağı, Edremit, Balıkesir

new.title: See Sütüven Waterfall in Kazdağı National Park
new.desc: A waterfall of about 17 m in the national park, with picnic areas, a roadside restaurant and honey stalls nearby.
new.tip: Rocks are slippery: bring water shoes if you want to wade in.
new.q: Sütüven Şelalesi, Kazdağı Milli Parkı, Edremit, Balıkesir

new.title: Soak in the thermal springs of Güre
new.desc: Güre, west of Edremit, has hot springs of about 64-65 degrees used since antiquity and linked to the ancient city of Astyra. Several hotels run thermal pools.
new.tip: Day entry depends on the hotel; check before going.
new.q: Güre Termal, Güre, Edremit, Balıkesir

new.title: Eat fresh fish at the Altınoluk fishing cooperative
new.desc: The S.S. Altınoluk Su Ürünleri Kooperatifi runs a harbour restaurant with highly rated fresh fish.
new.tip: Ask for the catch of the day.
new.q: Altınoluk Su Ürünleri Kooperatifi, Altınoluk, Edremit, Balıkesir

new.title: Eat Elbasan tava at Cumhuriyet Lokantası, Edremit
new.desc: An Edremit lokanta on İnönü Street known for Elbasan tava, lamb tandır and olive-oil dishes.
new.tip: Go at lunch.
new.q: Cumhuriyet Lokantası, Camivasat, İnönü Caddesi 10/A, Edremit, Balıkesir

new.title: Order höşmerim at Ahmet Efendi Yoğurt Evi, Edremit
new.desc: A dairy shop on İnönü Street known for yogurt, local cheeses and höşmerim, the warm fresh-cheese dessert of the region.
new.tip: Eat it warm.
new.q: Ahmet Efendi Yoğurt Evi, İnönü Caddesi 53, Gazi İlyas, Edremit, Balıkesir

new.title: Eat Edremit köfte at Köfteci Hilmi
new.desc: A busy köfte restaurant on a back street in Edremit, praised for its meatballs and generous portions. It has a rooftop-style dining area with a garden.
new.tip: Expect a queue at lunch. Order the köfte with piyaz and a side of grilled peppers.
new.q: Köfteci Hilmi Edremit, Prof. Dr. Necmettin Erbakan Caddesi 26, Hekimzade, Edremit, Balıkesir

new.title: Taste olive oil at Nermin Hanım Zeytinliği, Havran
new.desc: A factory shop and restaurant on the Edremit-Ayvalık road known for olive-oil tastings and breakfast.
new.tip: Good stop between Edremit and Ayvalık.
new.q: Nermin Hanım Zeytinliği, Edremit-Ayvalık yolu, Havran, Balıkesir

new.title: Visit the Havran City Museum in a 1912 mansion
new.desc: A restored 1912 brick-and-timber mansion museum on local history and Seyit Onbaşı, the Çanakkale war hero from Havran.
new.tip: Small museum; check opening hours.
new.q: Terzizade Konağı, Cumhuriyet Caddesi 123, Havran, Balıkesir

new.title: Swim at Ören Beach in Burhaniye
new.desc: A long Blue Flag beach on the Edremit Gulf with sunbeds, umbrellas and showers.
new.tip: Best in June or September.
new.q: Ören Plajı, Ören, Burhaniye, Balıkesir

new.title: Hike to the Çamlı Monastery on Cunda
new.desc: The ruined Çamlı Monastery lies in the pine hills on the western side of Cunda island. A forest walk leads to it from the road, with sea views on the way.
new.tip: Go in spring or autumn, as summer afternoons are hot. Carry water, as there are no shops.
new.q: Çamlı Manastırı, Alibey Adası, Ayvalık, Balıkesir

new.title: Tour the Kuva-yi Milliye Museum in Balıkesir
new.desc: A museum in an 1840 mansion of the Karesi district treasurer, with documents and belongings from the local resistance of the War of Independence and excavated artefacts.
new.tip: Closed on Mondays.
new.q: Kuvayi Milliye Müzesi, Karesi, Balıkesir

new.title: See the Zağnos Paşa Mosque in Balıkesir
new.desc: The remaining mosque and hamam of a complex built by Zağnos Paşa, a vizier of Mehmed II, in 1461.
new.tip: Free to enter outside prayer times.
new.q: Zağnos Paşa Camii, Karesi Sokak, Balıkesir

new.title: Spot the 1901 Balıkesir Clock Tower
new.desc: A square clock tower from 1901 with clocks on all four sides, built after the earlier round tower collapsed in 1897.
new.tip: Combine with the nearby museum.
new.q: Balıkesir Saat Kulesi, Balıkesir

new.title: Eat höşmerim at Mehmet Usta Höşmerimleri, Balıkesir
new.desc: A shop making höşmerim daily, with takeaway. Höşmerim comes from Havran and is made of fresh unsalted cheese, semolina and sugar.
new.tip: Eat it warm.
new.q: Mehmet Usta Höşmerimleri, Hisariçi, Dr. Ahmet Toprak Caddesi 1/D, Karesi, Balıkesir

new.title: Eat Balıkesir köfte at Köfteci Ahmet
new.desc: Traditional Balıkesir köfte made daily and served with piyaz and roasted pepper.
new.tip: Go at lunch.
new.q: Köfteci Ahmet, Akıncılar, Bozkurt Sokak, Karesi, Balıkesir

new.title: Walk the ruins of Kyzikos near Erdek
new.desc: A major ancient city of the Propontis whose mint made the Kyzikene electrum staters. The Temple of Hadrian and an amphitheatre wall survive; the city fell in an earthquake in 1063.
new.tip: Entry is free; go in spring or autumn.
new.q: Kyzikos Antik Kenti, Düzler, Erdek, Balıkesir

new.title: Find the Kirazlı Monastery in the Kapıdağ forest
new.desc: A ruined Greek Orthodox monastery from the 1890s with 99 rooms, deep in the Kapıdağ forest near Ballıpınar.
new.tip: Dirt road, no shops nearby; bring water.
new.q: Kirazlı Manastırı, Ballıpınar, Kapıdağ Yarımadası, Erdek, Balıkesir

new.title: Swim at Ocaklar Beach on the Kapıdağ peninsula
new.desc: A shallow, fine-sand beach popular with families, mostly public.
new.tip: Go on weekdays; sunbeds cost extra.
new.q: Ocaklar Plajı, Ocaklar, Erdek, Balıkesir

new.title: Watch birds at Manyas Kuşcenneti National Park
new.desc: A wetland reserve on Lake Manyas with over 230 recorded bird species, observation towers and walking routes.
new.tip: Best March to July for nesting birds, September-October for pelicans.
new.q: Kuşcenneti Milli Parkı, Bandırma, Balıkesir

new.title: Take a pelican boat trip from Bereketli
new.desc: A fishing village on Lake Manyas where boat trips go out to see pelicans, most popular in September.
new.tip: Book a boat on the quay; September is peak season.
new.q: Bereketli Köyü, Manyas, Balıkesir

new.title: Walk the Belkıs sand isthmus to Kapıdağ
new.desc: The Belkıs tombolo is a sandy isthmus about 1.5 km long that joins the Kapıdağ peninsula to the mainland. Dunes line the east shore, a beach the west shore, and marshland the middle.
new.tip: Visit in spring or autumn for birds and cooler walking. Two roads cross it, so park well off the road.
new.q: Belkıs Tombolu, Bandırma, Balıkesir

new.title: Walk the Saraylar marble open-air museum on Marmara Island
new.desc: An open-air museum on the northeast coast of Marmara Island, a marble and sculpture centre that supplied the Roman Empire, with many unfinished pieces.
new.tip: Check ferry schedules.
new.q: Saraylar Açık Hava Müzesi, Saraylar, Marmara, Balıkesir

new.title: See the Aya Yorgi monastery remains on Avşa
new.desc: A monastery dated 1638 at Manastır Cape on Avşa, with only part of the church remaining.
new.tip: About five minutes by car from the pier.
new.q: Avşa Manastırı, Yücetepe, Avşa Adası, Türkeli, Balıkesir

new.title: Taste Adakarası wine on Avşa
new.desc: Avşa is the only place in Turkey growing the Adakarası grape; the Bortaçina and Büyülübağ wineries receive visitors.
new.tip: Call ahead for tastings.
new.q: Bortaçina Şarapçılık, Avşa Adası, Türkeli, Balıkesir

new.title: Drink foamy ayran and eat tost at Yasa, Susurluk
new.desc: A rest stop on the Istanbul-İzmir motorway opened in 1995, known for foamy Susurluk ayran and the Susurluk tost with Mihaliç cheese.
new.tip: On the Susurluk stretch of the otoyol.
new.q: Yasa Dinlenme Tesisleri, İstanbul İzmir Otoyolu, Susurluk, Balıkesir

new.title: Eat Bigadiç güveç at Kardeşler Güveç Salonu
new.desc: A restaurant in Bigadiç serving the local oven güveç and saçaklı mantı.
new.tip: Order the güveç.
new.q: Kardeşler Kasap Izgara ve Güveç Salonu, Atatürk Caddesi 90, Bigadiç, Balıkesir

new.title: Visit Hisaralan Geopark near Sındırgı
new.desc: The Hisaralan Ida-Madra Geopark is among Sındırgı's key sights, with geological features and thermal springs.
new.tip: Go with a guide.
new.q: Hisaralan, Sındırgı, Balıkesir
